universes.name: NeuroAI organizations and exact systems
universes.purpose: Discover and maintain source-backed identities for organizations, programmes, products and exact systems relevant to NeuroAI.
inclusion_criteria: Public evidence supports a NeuroAI-relevant organization, programme, product or exact system identity.
exclusion_criteria: Name-only candidates without sufficient identity evidence.
Author collectives represented more accurately as provenance nodes.
languages: Additional languages through governed regional expansion
universes.retrieval_strategy: Controlled official-surface discovery plus explicit entity-resolution proposals and source-backed regional expansion.
universes.refresh_policy: Risk-based recurring monitoring for living organization/product surfaces; archival handling for fixed historical records.
universes.coverage_methodology: Declare frozen discovery strata or query programmes and report denominators/limitations; do not infer global completeness from record count.
known_blind_spots: Organizations without accessible official web presence.
Non-English ecosystems outside implemented language coverage.

universes.name: Scientific publications and preprints
universes.purpose: Identify primary scientific evidence, technical reports, preprints and publication corrections relevant to represented systems, models and datasets.
inclusion_criteria: Publication materially supports a represented NeuroAI system, model, dataset, benchmark, clinical study or assessment question.
exclusion_criteria: Pure commentary without evidentiary relevance unless retained as explicitly secondary context.
universes.retrieval_strategy: Structured bibliographic discovery supplemented by exact DOI/title/author reconciliation and bounded repository searches.
universes.refresh_policy: Recurring discovery for new publications; fixed articles become archival while corrections/retractions remain monitored through source-specific mechanisms.
universes.coverage_methodology: Track declared query streams, indexing sources, search windows, deduplication, and sampled missed-result review.
known_blind_spots: Publication metadata without accessible full text.
Non-English and regional indexes not yet integrated.

universes.name: Clinical studies and trial registries
universes.purpose: Maintain explicit study, trial, status, endpoint and site evidence for NeuroAI systems with clinical research activity.
inclusion_criteria: Registry or primary study evidence identifies a NeuroAI-relevant intervention, system or exact assessment dependency.
exclusion_criteria: Trial-site relationships inferred only from institutional existence.
universes.retrieval_strategy: Structured registry retrieval keyed by controlled identifiers and bounded successor discovery across official registries.
universes.refresh_policy: Recurring monitoring while recruitment, follow-up, status or results posting can change.
universes.coverage_methodology: Report registry scope, query/identifier strategy, monitored-record denominator, and unresolved cross-registry matches.
known_blind_spots: Registries without stable public structured access.

universes.name: NeuroAI models and checkpoints
universes.purpose: Represent model families, released checkpoints, announced roadmaps, training/evaluation claims and model lineage without conflating them.
universes.unit: model family, checkpoint or model-release record
inclusion_criteria: Primary or controlled scientific evidence establishes a NeuroAI-relevant model, checkpoint or roadmap identity.
exclusion_criteria: Treating a roadmap announcement as evidence that a checkpoint exists.
Treating a paper title as a unique model identity without resolution.
universes.retrieval_strategy: Publication/repository discovery with persistent-identifier and developer/author entity resolution.
universes.refresh_policy: Recurring discovery for new releases/checkpoints; archival preservation of fixed model publications and releases.
universes.coverage_methodology: Track declared repositories/reviews/query streams and distinguish enumerated review universes from the global model universe.

universes.name: Neuroscience datasets and benchmarks
universes.purpose: Identify datasets, benchmark universes and dataset/model lineage relevant to NeuroAI evaluation and training claims.
inclusion_criteria: A dataset or benchmark is explicitly relevant to a represented model/system or to a governed source-universe programme.
exclusion_criteria: Automatically expanding registry-level aggregate counts into individual canonical dataset entities without identity evidence.
universes.retrieval_strategy: Controlled registry/repository enumeration plus explicit dataset identity and model-lineage reconciliation.
universes.refresh_policy: Release-aware discovery and periodic registry refresh.
universes.coverage_methodology: Preserve registry-reported denominators and limitations; separately report individually resolved canonical datasets.

universes.name: Regulatory, legal and post-market evidence
universes.purpose: Track exact jurisdiction- and configuration-scoped regulatory states and relevant post-market actions.
inclusion_criteria: Official regulator or legal source materially bears on a represented system, device, indication, configuration or assessment dependency.
exclusion_criteria: Inferring authorization from company marketing language where an applicable official record is required.
universes.retrieval_strategy: Official regulator/legal sources prioritized, with structured adapters where available and explicit source-route resilience.
universes.refresh_policy: High-priority recurring monitoring for living regulatory records and relevant post-market sources; on-change monitoring for legal/normative text.
universes.coverage_methodology: Report jurisdictions and regulator surfaces actually implemented; never generalize one jurisdictional state globally.
known_blind_spots: Regulatory databases without stable public access.

universes.name: Public research funding and grants
universes.purpose: Represent source-backed public funding events and programme support relevant to NeuroAI entities and research infrastructure.
inclusion_criteria: Official funding data identifies a relevant award, recipient and programme relationship.
exclusion_criteria: Treating award amount as evidence of research success, effectiveness or commercial strength.
universes.retrieval_strategy: Structured public funding databases prioritized; entity resolution binds recipients and programmes.
universes.refresh_policy: Periodic discovery plus event-triggered updates for represented entities.
universes.coverage_methodology: Declare funder/database scope and time window; report unmatched recipient identities separately.

universes.name: Patents and public intellectual-property records
universes.purpose: Represent public patent identities, applicants/assignees and relevant technology lineage without equating patents with deployed capability.
universes.unit: patent/application family or controlled IP event
inclusion_criteria: Public patent-office evidence has a materially relevant NeuroAI technology or entity connection.
exclusion_criteria: Inferring product implementation, freedom to operate, validity or commercial success from patent existence alone.
universes.retrieval_strategy: Official patent identifiers and family reconciliation; aggregators may generate candidates but not control canonical claims.
universes.refresh_policy: Periodic discovery and status updates where supported by official records.
universes.coverage_methodology: Declare offices, classifications, assignee queries and time windows; measure entity-resolution ambiguity.

universes.name: Capital, financing and ownership
universes.purpose: Represent dated financing, acquisition, ownership and control evidence at event level with explicit amount/control boundaries.
inclusion_criteria: Primary company, investor, official filing or equivalent controlled evidence identifies a relevant event.
exclusion_criteria: Inferring valuation, profitability, cash availability or technological quality without separate evidence.
universes.retrieval_strategy: Event discovery from controlled organization/investor/public-filing surfaces with explicit counterparty entity resolution.
universes.refresh_policy: Event-driven discovery plus periodic represented-entity review.
universes.coverage_methodology: Declare covered primary-source surfaces and distinguish undisclosed amounts/control states from missing collection.
known_blind_spots: Ownership terms not disclosed in announcements.

universes.name: Technical standards and assurance frameworks
universes.purpose: Track official standards and committee outputs materially relevant to NeuroAI systems and assurance questions.
universes.unit: standard, standard revision or official committee record
inclusion_criteria: Official standards evidence is materially relevant to represented NeuroAI technology, safety, data, software or governance questions.
exclusion_criteria: Treating standards-body existence as evidence that a system conforms to a standard.
universes.retrieval_strategy: Controlled standards-body monitoring and identifier/version tracking.
universes.coverage_methodology: Declare standards bodies and topics covered; separate relevance from system-specific conformance evidence.
known_blind_spots: Jurisdiction-specific assurance frameworks not yet mapped.

universes.name: Policy and governance instruments
universes.purpose: Track official policy, legal, ethics and governance instruments that define context without converting them into system-specific authorization or conformance claims.
universes.unit: policy, recommendation, law, guidance or governance instrument
inclusion_criteria: Official instrument is materially relevant to NeuroAI governance or an exact assessment context.
exclusion_criteria: Policy commentary lacking official status unless retained as explicitly secondary evidence.
universes.retrieval_strategy: Official institutional source tracking with version/effective-date preservation.
universes.refresh_policy: On-change and periodic review for living instruments.
universes.coverage_methodology: Declare institutions, jurisdictions and instrument classes included; preserve exact applicability boundaries.
known_blind_spots: Non-English policy sources not yet integrated.

universes.name: Participant and affected-community authority
universes.purpose: Represent source-backed participant, patient and affected-community powers, roles and governance relationships with exact scope.
inclusion_criteria: Controlled evidence explicitly documents a participant, patient or affected-community power or participation role.
exclusion_criteria: Inferring voting, veto, consent, co-design or governance authority from organization membership, registry interest or study participation alone.
universes.retrieval_strategy: Assessment- and programme-linked evidence discovery with human review because authority semantics are highly context-sensitive.
universes.refresh_policy: Event- and assessment-driven; recurring monitoring only for living governance sources where justified.
universes.coverage_methodology: Report exact cases and powers documented; do not interpret sparse evidence as absence of participant authority globally.
known_blind_spots: Affected-community structures not visible in public sources.

authority_boundary: This registry defines planned and bounded discovery programmes only. It creates no claim of global completeness, source authenticity, scientific truth, system conformance, or canonical publication authority.
